title: Correction: Neonatal blood lead concentration predicts medium term lead-related outcomes in children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning: A retrospective cohort study in Northern Nigeria.
ehr_evidence: The study used data from MSF.
summary: This retrospective cohort study in Northern Nigeria examined whether neonatal blood lead concentration predicts medium-term lead-related outcomes in children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning.
population: children ≤5 years old with congenital lead poisoning in Northern Nigeria
